style: Original art-directed sports poster, not a photograph of the real event. One or two figures only, the rest of the frame is design: a single dominant colour, hard graphic light, vast negative space, the figure rendered as a monumental silhouette or rim-lit form. The one gesture that defines the moment, larger than life. No text, no logos, no jersey lettering or numbers, no identifiable faces, no real people.

moments.title: The Last Shot
moments.prompt: A lone shooter frozen in a perfect follow-through, wrist bent, fingers pointing at the rim, seen from behind and below against a wall of blinding white light. The whole arena is reduced to one giant glowing scoreboard reading 5.2 in the dark above him. Red figure, black void, white light.

moments.title: The Block
moments.prompt: Shot from directly behind the backboard: a hand and forearm slamming a basketball flat against the glass, the shooter's hand still underneath it, both arms stretched to their limit. Wine-red and gold light, the glass cracking into a star pattern around the ball, nothing else in frame.

moments.title: The Flu Game
moments.prompt: A player on his knees at centre court, head bowed, one hand on the floor, the court's centre circle glowing beneath him like a halo, everything else black. A single beam of light from above. Red uniform, grey-green sickly tint in the shadows, sweat catching the light.

moments.title: From the Line
moments.prompt: A player in flight, body perfectly horizontal, seen in strict side profile like a figure on an ancient vase, the ball held high in one hand. Below him the free-throw line glows as the only mark on a black floor and a dotted arc traces his flight from the line to the rim. Red and gold on black.

moments.title: The Skyhook
moments.prompt: An impossibly tall figure in goggles releasing a hook shot, arm straight up, the ball at the very top of the frame, the shot's arc drawn as a thin golden line curving toward a rim that sits beyond the edge of the picture. Purple and gold, the figure elongated like a cathedral spire.

moments.title: The Junior Skyhook
moments.prompt: A point guard mid-stride across the lane, lofting a running one-handed hook, the ball leaving his fingertips in a shaft of gold light, two defenders behind him dissolved into green smoke. Gold figure, green haze, a clock reading :02 burned faintly into the dark.

moments.title: The Shrug
moments.prompt: A player seen from the front, shoulders raised, palms turned up, head tilted, the universal shrug, lit from below like a statue. Six basketballs hang in a perfect row in the air above him like a halo. Red figure on a deep black field.

moments.title: The Dream Shake
moments.prompt: A centre on the low block drawn as a multiple exposure: four ghost images of the same figure pivoting one way, then the other, then up, the final one solid and rising for the shot. One defender stands frozen, leaning the wrong way. Scarlet and gold on black, the motion trail glowing.

moments.title: The Stepover
moments.prompt: Shot from floor level: a small guard with an arm sleeve and cornrows stepping over a fallen opponent, his foot huge in the foreground, his face in shadow, the fallen player a purple-and-gold shape sprawled across the floor. White figure, the floor glowing white, a single hard spotlight.

moments.title: The Lob
moments.prompt: A basketball hanging at the apex of its arc at the very top of the frame, and far below two giant hands rising to meet it, the rest of the player's body falling into darkness. Gold light, the ball's arc drawn as a thin bright line from the bottom corner. Nothing else.

moments.title: From the Logo
moments.prompt: A slight guard releasing a jumper from a distance so absurd the rim is a tiny bright circle at the far top of the frame, the ball a glowing dot halfway there, the court stretched to a vanishing point between them. Blue and gold on a black floor, the half-court circle glowing under his feet.

moments.title: The Dagger
moments.prompt: A shooter at the top of a step-back, the defender's outstretched hand a half-second late, the ball leaving his hand with a long bright trail that turns into the shape of a dagger blade. Wine-red and gold, 53 seconds glowing faintly in the black.

moments.title: Eighty-One
moments.prompt: A guard in purple walking alone off a court, back to camera, the hardwood behind him covered in eighty-one glowing shot marks, each a small burst of light, forming a constellation over the floor. Black arena, purple figure, gold sparks.

moments.title: The First Team
moments.prompt: Five colossal silhouettes standing in a line on the horizon of an empty, glowing court the size of a city, seen from far away and below like mountains, light pouring between them. Each silhouette a different colour. The final boss of a climb through basketball history.
